To request copies of your medical records from West End Chiropractic:
Include your full name, date of birth, phone number, approximate dates of treatment, and preferred delivery method.
A valid government-issued photo ID may be required prior to release of records. Records are released in accordance with applicable Texas law and HIPAA requirements.
